asset_set: Questionnaire Q2 option 1 — Creating digital artwork for a game

questionnaire.choice_text: Creating digital artwork for a game

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under drawing tablet and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; two faint diagonal hatch lines suggesting screen glass reflection on tablet only
art_style.mood: playful creative-studio energy — approachable digital art hobby, not corporate game-dev office
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: KursoKo gold
accent.use: selected color swatch, stylus grip band, sleeve cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: in-progress character sprite outline glow, palette fan accent

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: gold appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on tablet screen edge and stylus tip
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and tablet base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: steadies a graphics drawing tablet flat on the desk
left_hand.grip: flat palm along the tablet's far edge, fingers relaxed
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: shades the wing of a small game creature sprite with a stylus
right_hand.grip: precision pen grip, stylus tip touching the screen
right_hand.position: center-right, hovering over the sprite artwork

pose.gesture_summary: mid-illustration freeze frame — one shading stroke in progress
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

accessories.placement: right hand only — smudge-guard style, fingertips exposed

subject.choice_label: Creating digital artwork for a game
subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands works on a drawing tablet, mid-stroke shading the wing of a small fantasy-creature game sprite that is only half colored in. A fanned color swatch and a second reference sprite sketch sit beside the tablet, capturing the playful energy of building a game's visual world one character at a time.

primary_objects.name: drawing tablet with in-progress sprite
primary_objects.detail: lavender-tinted canvas showing a small winged creature sprite, half line-art and half colored

primary_objects.name: stylus pen
primary_objects.detail: gold grip band, nib touching the tablet glass

primary_objects.name: fanned color swatch cards
primary_objects.detail: five overlapping color chips fanned like a hand of cards, no readable labels

primary_objects.name: reference sprite sketch sheet
primary_objects.size_relative: small accent — tucked under tablet corner
primary_objects.detail: loose pencil thumbnails of the same creature in different poses

subject.environment: light birch desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no wall or monitor

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from swatch fan → tablet sprite → shading hand
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: tablet silhouette + sprite shape + two hands readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter A, UI chrome, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, gore, violence, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector education illustration, 640x640 square, transparent PNG background. KursoKo career quiz choice image for activity "Creating digital artwork for a game". Style: friendly flat vector with consistent 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, solid fills, minimal cel shadow under hands only — match KursoKo RIASEC sticker art family but NO letter, NO border frame, NO text on image. Scene: two forearms in a soft steel-blue hoodie sleeve with gold cuff stripe, right hand wearing a fingerless art glove. Left hand steadies a drawing tablet on a birch desk edge; the lavender-tinted canvas #F5F0FF shows a small winged creature game sprite, half line-art and half colored in sky-blue #81D4FA. Right hand shades the wing with a light-grey stylus with a gold grip band. A fanned orange #FF8A65 color-swatch card set and a loose pencil reference sketch rest beside the tablet. Warm medium skin tone #C8956C. Three-quarter top-down camera, hands in lower half, generous transparent margins. Mood: playful imaginative maker energy. Readable silhouette at small thumbnail size.
